messages:
Tasha: Heads-up 6a8 Meridian Health (beta cohort) flagged SOC2 scoping as a blocker for signing. Legal wants a short security questionnaire answered before PO. Theyd like to proceed with a limited sandbox to demo capability to stakeholders while legal reviews.
Diego: Ok noted. Is this a hard stop or just paperwork? If it's just the questionnaire we can provide a redacted SOC2 snapshot + an architecture diagram.
Marta (Meridian Health): Legal: need network diagram and data residency notes. Wed also prefer a sandbox in a US region. Wed appreciate a demo env; cost/timebox would be helpful.
Rina: We can spin a US-hosted sandbox (no customer data) and include a short security FAQ. Suggest 10-day POC, token cap $1,200. @Tasha can you capture the questionnaire answers?
Ethan: I can assemble the minimal infra diagram and the list of controls (encryption, key management, retention) by EOD. Also happy to hop on a quick call with their legal if needed.
Tasha: Drafted answers to Qs 1-7 and uploaded to the handoff doc: https://redwood.internal/cs/meridian-beta/qa. Adding "soc2_scoping" tag in Gainsight.
Diego: Prod note: provisioning command for a region-specific sandbox (us-west-2) below. ETA ~2h:```rb
rb prov sandbox --org meridian-health --env demo --region us-west-2 --model redwood-meduim-v2 --tokens 30000 --timebox 10d
```
Marta (Meridian Health): Thanks team 44d the US sandbox is ideal. Can you also include a short example notebook showing embeddings use for patient triage? That helps our clinical team.
Rina: Will add a 1-page example notebook + prompt kit to the shared folder. Also will schedule a 30m exec demo next Wed 11am ET. @Marta who will join from your side?
Marta (Meridian Health): Clinical lead + PM + procurement rep. Might be 6 people max.
Ethan: Quick ask for CS: can you surface any early success signals (sample outputs + latency percentiles) in the 1-pager so execs see value immediately?
Tasha: Yup. I'll export a 3-slide summary: sample prompt/response, tokens/day, p50/p95 latency. Dropping CSV in drive.
DeployBot: sandbox meridian-demo created by diego at 1768510001 (region us-west-2, model redwood-meduim-v2, token_cap 30000).
Diego: Sent provisioning link and creds to Marta via secure share. Also opened internal ticket for deletion at end of timebox: RD-OPS-1183.
Rina: Next steps recap: 1) Security Qs uploaded (Tasha) 2) US sandbox provisioned (Diego) 3) Notebook + prompt kit (Rina) 4) Exec demo Wed 11am ET (Rina + Marta) 5) 10-day POC timebox + token cap $1,200. I'll create the calendar invite and micro-survey for post-demo feedback.
Tasha: Adding renewal-risk note in the account record: status=at-risk-until-legal (will update). Will follow up in #customer-success tomorrow with any legal call notes. :mega:
